UPDATE session_requests
         SET status = 'approved',
             session_key_id = ?,
             approved_by = ?,
             approved_at = datetime('now'),
             wrap_key_type = ?, wrap_nonce = ?, wrap_ciphertext = ?, wrap_aad = ?,
             wrap_ephemeral_pub = ?, wrap_dek_nonce = ?, wrap_encrypted_dek = ?
         WHERE id = ? AND status = 'pending'
